quotes.name: Elena Leon
quotes.quote: Elle? She's got that quiet strength about her—the kind that keeps the port running smooth even when the tides turn. I've seen her maneuver those tugs like they're extensions of her own body. As for Jack London... well, the money's moving differently these days. More glass towers going up where the old warehouses stood, but the docks? We're holding steady. You can feel the shift though—like the whole neighborhood's holding its breath waiting to see who benefits and who gets left behind.

I've seen her maneuver those tugs like they're extensions of her own body. As for Jack London... well, the money's moving differently these days. More glass towers going up where the old warehouses stood, but the docks? We're holding steady. You can feel the shift though—like the whole neighborhood's holding its breath waiting to see who benefits and who gets left behind.
interviews.disp: driven, hard to sit still; magnetic, center of every room; warm, tender with people; curious, open to new things; steady, hard to shake; devoted, family is everything; often out in the neighborhood
